decisions.reason: The schlager compilation is a low-cost catalog item in a warehouse-backed shop, but it is no longer visible after 2019 and may be sold out or deprioritised, so the risk of dropping it is moderate while there is no clear shortfall that would trigger search.
The illustrated release series is a multi-model line tied to the firm's curation strength and its broadening strategy, and growing industry turnover gives it the slack to keep carrying the line.
Reissued jazz vinyl sits at the core of the label's expertise and serves the growing vinyl collector market, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason to drop it.
A multi-disc box set is a limited, high-value collector item that can stay in the catalog until stock runs out at little cost, and nothing signals a shortfall.
The compilation CD was only mentioned on the website and CD demand is weaker, but carrying it in the catalog costs little, so keeping it is reasonable while its results stay uncertain.
